title: 🎉 Clock Lock Issue FIXED — Update Now!
message:
Great news, Exam Prep Family!

The "Clock Lock" and "Security Lockout" issues that frustrated many of you have been completely resolved in the new version.

Here's what you need to know:

✅ The Problem Is Gone
No more clock lock screens. No more "Enable Automatic Time" messages. No more getting blocked when you've done nothing wrong.

✅ What Else Is New
• Instant license activation after payment
• Smoother app performance
• Improved anti-cheat that doesn't punish innocent users
• Redesigned dialogs for a cleaner look
• Fixed update system

📥 How to Update
Tap "OPEN" below to download the latest version directly.

After installing, your premium access will be restored automatically. No need to re-enter your key.
